call_points.text: MEL Phase 2 is expected to add about USD 200 million of revenue.
Zambia energy EBITDA margin is guided at 45-50%; the decline was due to lower ECL credit reversal.
Consolidated EBITDA is guided at 35-40% of segment EBITDA after intersegment eliminations.
About 70% of metals production is committed under long-term or quarterly contracts.
The Orissa metals unit was shut for maintenance in Q1 and resumed on 1 August.
Phase 2 finance cost is capitalised, so finance cost has not risen with the loan.
A third-party study on options for the land bank is ongoing; no value disclosed.
Silico manganese sales guided at about 130,000 tons for FY27; ferro silicon has been discontinued.
Q4 EBITDA fell QoQ on ₹18 Cr lower other income and a planned shutdown at Maamba.
Employee costs rose on ESOPs, labour code and wage hikes; management called the higher level sustainable.
Avocado peak revenue expected at $22 million, reached post 2032, with harvest doubling yearly.
Kwacha appreciation creates a non-cash deferred tax charge at Maamba; management says cash flow is unaffected.
Lithium exploration in Mapatizya is on hold pending ministry review of a competing licence claim.

guidance.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin guided at 35-40% for FY27.
Silico manganese sales volume expected at about 130,000 tons for FY27.
Avocado peak revenue expected at $22 million, reached post 2032.
MEL Phase 2 to add about USD 200 million of revenue
Return on equity on the additional 300 MW envisaged at about 15%
Zambia energy segment EBITDA margin sustainable at 45-50%
Consolidated EBITDA at 35-40% of segment EBITDA
Sugar plant revenue of USD 55-60 million per annum from Q4FY28
Nava Global dividend policy of at least 30% of PAT

operating_notes.text: Domestic power realisation guided at about INR 5.50 per unit for the current year.
Ferroalloy sales are 40% under a yearly Japanese contract, 40-50% under quarterly Indian steel contracts, and only 10-15% exposed to spot.
Singareni Collieries cut coal prices in September 2025, allowing higher PLF and more bilateral contracts in Telangana.
MEL's 300 MW plant ran at 89.3 PLF in Q1FY27.
About 70% of metals production is committed under long-term or quarterly contracts, with spot prices up 5-10% quarter-on-quarter.
Manganese exploration covered 2 sq km of a 360 sq km concession, with prima facie promising results.

timeline.summary: On May 15, 2026, Nava's Q4FY26 call guided FY27 EBITDA margin at 35-40% and set 100 MW solar commissioning for July 2026 and 300 MW Maamba Phase 2 for January 2027.
On its 14 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Nava said MEL Phase 2 commissioning had slipped to Q2FY28 and the 100 MW Zambia solar plant would be commissioned by end-September 2026.

upcoming_events.description: 100 MW solar project commissioning to commence
100 MW Zambia solar project expected commissioned by end-September 2026
300 MW Maamba Phase 2 thermal expansion commissioned
